GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5  # zod (high) - can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections - patched only in 4.6.6; zod 3 is direct in api, shared, webapp and land and transitive via privy, scalar, reown and eslint-plugin-react-hooks; remove once the zod 4 migration (#1290) and those dependencies move off zod 3
GHSA-qr28-fpjm-wq7f  # decode-uri-component (high) - quadratic DoS decoding percent-encoded runs - patched only in ESM-only 0.5.1; transitive via @privy-io/react-auth 2 -> @walletconnect/utils 2.21 -> query-string 7.1.3 (CJS require, override breaks it); remove with the Privy 3 upgrade
